external_sources.provider: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis FRED

point_in_time_mapping.rule: For a TSE session dated D, use the latest external observation whose US observation_date is strictly earlier than D.
point_in_time_mapping.carry_rule: A prior US trading observation may bridge US or Japanese holidays but its source date is retained.
point_in_time_mapping.interpretation: These are completed US-market and FX observations, not proxies for an exact 08:58 futures snapshot.

hypotheses.definition: For each stock, estimate a shifted rolling-60 beta of TSE open-to-close return to the pre-open S&P 500 close-to-close return; rank by beta times current pre-open S&P return.
hypotheses.prediction: Stable stock heterogeneity in post-open continuation or reversal of US shocks improves ranking.

hypotheses.definition: Estimate a shifted rolling-60 beta to NASDAQ minus S&P 500 return and multiply by the current growth spread.
hypotheses.prediction: Growth-sensitive Japanese stocks react differently during the TSE session.

hypotheses.definition: Estimate a shifted rolling-60 beta to the latest pre-open USD/JPY return and multiply by the current FX move.
hypotheses.prediction: Exporter and importer response heterogeneity remains after the opening auction.

hypotheses.definition: Estimate a shifted rolling-60 beta to VIX percentage change and multiply by the current pre-open VIX change.
hypotheses.prediction: Stock-specific fear sensitivity predicts intraday continuation or recovery.

hypotheses.definition: Cross-sectionally standardize X01 through X04 each day and average them.
hypotheses.prediction: Combining independent external shocks is more robust than a single market series.

hypotheses.definition: Add X01 through X04 and current common-state interactions with prior stock behavior to the fixed price-core daily-rank Ridge.
hypotheses.prediction: A conditional model extracts nonlinear state dependence not captured by standalone beta signals.

hypotheses.definition: Interact point-in-time TDnet material categories with current S&P, growth-spread, VIX and FX shocks in an event-specific model.
hypotheses.prediction: Material news is absorbed differently depending on the overseas risk state.

hypotheses.definition: Fit separate strictly-prior ranking experts for positive, neutral and negative S&P shock regimes and route each date using the current pre-open S&P return.
hypotheses.prediction: Continuation and reversal mechanisms differ by overseas shock direction.
